subject: Conditional archive escrow and TTL alignment discussion
messages:
From: Laura Chen <laura.chen@northwell-analytics.com>
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwoodinference.com, karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com
Cc: kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 9 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: temporary retain for upcoming audit + log retention exception

Hi Stephanie / Karthik,

We have an external compliance audit starting 2026-11-20 and the auditors have asked for a 90-day temporary retain on a subset of transaction logs associated with our integration environment (env: northwell-int-1). Specifically they need:

- All request/response logs for the period 2026-08-01 → 2026-11-20 (index + raw logs)
- Backup snapshots that cover the same window (to allow restore testing)
- Short-lived escalation evidence tied to the DPA Annex B (custody & deletion proof)

Can Redwood put a time-limited hold (90 days) on purge for those artifacts and issue a short annex that documents the retention exception and the subprocessors involved? We attached the audit intake summary.

Also: please point us to the DocuSign/annex flow if one is required.

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call if helpful.

Best,
Laura Chen
Head of Audit Operations
Northwell Analytics

Attachment: Northwell_Audit_Request.pdf
From: stephanie_nguyen@redwoodinference.com
To: Laura Chen <laura.chen@northwell-analytics.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com, kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 9 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: temporary retain for upcoming audit + log retention exception

Laura — thanks for the clear ask and the intake details. We can support a time-limited retain and provide the annex that lists subprocessors and the evidence retention steps. High level proposal below: 

1) Scope: request/response logs and backup snapshots for northwell-int-1 covering 2026-08-01 → 2026-11-20.
2) Hold period: 90 days starting 2026-11-21 (auto-expire 2027-02-19) unless extended by mutual written consent.
3) Technical controls:
   - Create an immutable snapshot escrow that prevents purge on matching snapshots.
   - Mark matching logs with a temporary hold flag in the retention index so automated purges ignore them.
   - Provide a restore window playbook and a one-time restore run for auditor validation.
4) Evidence: we will produce a retention-exception annex (PDF), a short runbook, and a signed DocuSign flow.

Action items for Northwell: confirm the exact bucket prefixes and if any PII redaction is required for auditor access. Action items for Redwood: draft annex + timeline (attached).

I've attached the initial timeline and internal task split — please review and I'll kick off the internal approval.

Thanks,
Stephanie Nguyen
Manager, Customer Trust & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Attachment: RI_proposed_timeline.xlsx
From: karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwoodinference.com
Cc: kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com, Laura Chen <laura.chen@northwell-analytics.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Nov 2026 13:27:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: temporary retain for upcoming audit + log retention exception

Looping in a couple of technical notes from the serving/runtime side — internal summary below (quick):

- Backup purge timeline: scheduled incremental purges run nightly 02:30 UTC; we will add a pre-check to skip objects tagged with northwell-audit-hold.
- Snapshot escrow: we'll create an immutable snapshot and place an escrow marker that prevents lifecycle rules from expiring it. Snapshot storage cost will be charged to the customer account during the hold.
- KV cache/restore: ephemeral KV caches are not part of the preserved artifacts; we will provide a validated restore from snapshot to a validation tenant for auditors.

One ask: if Northwell expects auditors to spin up a validation environment, we need at least 72 hours notice to schedule a restore across our dedicated capacity windows.

-Karthik
Senior Product Engineer, Inference Runtime
Redwood Inference
From: Laura Chen <laura.chen@northwell-analytics.com>
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwoodinference.com
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com, kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary retain for upcoming audit + log retention exception

Thanks — this looks good. We confirm the prefixes: s3://northwell-prod/logs/integration/* and s3://northwell-prod/backups/northwell-int-1/*. No PII redaction required for the auditor copies (they are under NDA).

Please prepare the annex and send the DocuSign link; procurement will need the annex attached to the ordering flow. Also confirm estimated incremental storage cost for the 90-day hold so we can route the charge.

DocuSign question: will Redwood accept a single-signer annex (Northwell + Redwood) or do you require buyer legal + procurement signatures separately?

Best,
Laura
From: stephanie_nguyen@redwoodinference.com
To: Laura Chen <laura.chen@northwell-analytics.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com, kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 15:40:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary retain for upcoming audit + log retention exception

Laura — all set. Next steps and confirmations: 

- Annex & DocuSign: we will send a single annex that supports signature by an authorized Northwell signer and an authorized Redwood signer. Procurement can attach the annex to the PO; DocuSign link will be sent within 24 hours.
- Cost estimate: ~USD 2,700 incremental storage + snapshot storage for 90 days (ballpark) — final invoice line will be produced after snapshot size calculation.
- Scheduler: please provide your preferred 72-hour window for a restore run; we will reserve the slot once you send availability.
- Subprocessors: Annex will list our storage subprocessor (CloudStore Inc.), analytics subprocessor (LogiqOps Ltd.), and backup handling partner (ColdVault Systems).

HubSpot: NDW-1482. Drive folder with supporting evidence will be shared: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-retention-evidence

I'll send the DocuSign link (na-docsign.example/ds/0A1B2C3) and the annex doc attached once the legal team finalizes the final wording.

Thanks all — tagging @kimberly_park for legal signoff scheduling.

—Stephanie
Manager, Customer Trust & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Attachment: retention-exception-annex.docx
